title: Python: a handle of a table in a block content control reads its location at each call
symptom: a Table or Cell handle of a table written in a block content control (as Google Docs writes one) has no owner record: it reads its location at each call (one scan of its story), and a structural edit through it (Table.replace_xml, Table.add_row, a cell's replace_xml) retires every other handle of the document
workaround: fetch handles again after such an edit (doc.tables, Cell.tables); for many such tables, read and edit them by location in Rust (Document::story_tables, table_element_xml, edit_story_table)
